senses.gloss: Knowledge or skill gained through involvement in or exposure to events, or the process of undergoing events.
senses.note: Derived from Middle English experience, from Old French, from Latin experientia ("a trial, proof, experiment, experimental knowledge, experience"), from experiens, present participle of experiri ("to try, put to the test, undertake, undergo"), from ex ("out") + peritus ("experienced, expert"). Displaced native Old English āfandung. Wiktionary, CC BY-SA 4.0.
